import urllib.request as ur
import urllib.parse as up
import http.cookiejar
import hashlib
import json
import re
import time

USER_AGENT = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'

def make_opener():
    cj = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
    opener = ur.build_opener(ur.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj))
    opener.addheaders = [
        ('User-Agent', USER_AGENT),
        ('Accept', 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8'),
        ('Accept-Language', 'en-US,en;q=0.9'),
    ]
    return opener, cj

def solve_pow(challenge_data: str, difficulty: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
    half = difficulty // 2
    odd = difficulty % 2 != 0
    nonce = 0
    while True:
        h = hashlib.sha256(f'{challenge_data}{nonce}'.encode()).digest()
        ok = True
        for s in range(half):
            if h[s] != 0:
                ok = False
                break
        if ok and odd and (h[half] >> 4) != 0:
            ok = False
        if ok:
            return h.hex(), nonce
        nonce += 1

def fetch_challenge(opener, url, referer='https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38'):
    req = ur.Request(url)
    req.add_header('Referer', referer)
    with opener.open(req, timeout=30) as r:
        return r.url, r.read().decode(), dict(r.headers)

def main():
    opener, cj = make_opener()
    # 1. Visit dataset page first to look natural
    opener.open(ur.Request('https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38'), timeout=30).read()
    print(f'After dataset page: {len(cj)} cookies')
    for c in cj:
        print(f'  {c.name}={c.value[:40]}... domain={c.domain}')

    # 2. Fetch the file_stream URL to get the challenge page
    target_url = 'https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/3407'
    final_url, body, headers = fetch_challenge(opener, target_url)
    print(f'\nChallenge page final_url={final_url}, body_len={len(body)}')

    # 3. Extract the challenge JSON
    m = re.search(r'<script id="anubis_challenge" type="application/json">(.+?)</script>', body, re.DOTALL)
    if not m:
        print('FAIL: no challenge JSON found')
        print(body[:1500])
        return
    challenge_json = json.loads(m.group(1).strip())
    print(f'Challenge JSON parsed:')
    print(json.dumps(challenge_json, indent=2)[:500])

    rules = challenge_json['rules']
    challenge = challenge_json['challenge']
    difficulty = rules['difficulty']
    data = challenge['randomData']
    cid = challenge['id']
    print(f'\nSolving PoW: difficulty={difficulty}, data={data[:30]}..., id={cid}')

    start = time.time()
    hash_hex, nonce = solve_pow(data, difficulty)
    elapsed_ms = int((time.time() - start) * 1000)
    print(f'Found: nonce={nonce}, hash={hash_hex[:32]}..., elapsed={elapsed_ms}ms')

    # 4. Submit pass-challenge
    params = {
        'id': cid,
        'response': hash_hex,
        'nonce': str(nonce),
        'redir': target_url,
        'elapsedTime': str(elapsed_ms),
    }
    pass_url = 'https://datadryad.org/.within.website/x/cmd/anubis/api/pass-challenge?' + up.urlencode(params)
    print(f'\nSubmitting pass-challenge: {pass_url[:120]}...')

    # IMPORTANT: do not follow redirect to target_url automatically yet; capture cookies first.
    class NoRedirect(ur.HTTPRedirectHandler):
        def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
            return None
    opener2 = ur.build_opener(ur.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), NoRedirect)
    opener2.addheaders = opener.addheaders
    req = ur.Request(pass_url)
    req.add_header('Referer', final_url)
    try:
        r = opener2.open(req, timeout=30)
        print(f'pass-challenge status={r.status}')
        print(f'  Location={r.headers.get("Location")}')
        body2 = r.read()
        print(f'  body_len={len(body2)}')
    except ur.HTTPError as e:
        print(f'pass-challenge HTTPError {e.code}: {e.reason}')
        print(f'  Location={e.headers.get("Location")}')
        print(f'  Set-Cookie={e.headers.get("Set-Cookie", "")[:200]}')
    print(f'\nCookies after pass-challenge: {len(cj)}')
    for c in cj:
        print(f'  {c.name}={c.value[:40]}... domain={c.domain}')

    # 5. Re-fetch the original URL
    print(f'\nRe-fetching {target_url}')
    req = ur.Request(target_url)
    req.add_header('Referer', 'https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38')
    r = opener.open(req, timeout=60)
    print(f'final_url={r.url}, status={r.status}')
    print(f'  content-type={r.headers.get("Content-Type")}')
    print(f'  content-length={r.headers.get("Content-Length")}')
    print(f'  content-disposition={r.headers.get("Content-Disposition")}')
    head = r.read(2000)
    print(f'  first 200 bytes: {head[:200]!r}')

main()
